say:0:1027102001:0.text: Ha! Damian's annoying Uncle Dyan again.
say:0:1027102001:0.source_cn: 啊哈，达米安又在烦迪恩大叔了。

say:1:1027102002:0.text: I wonder what he's up to this time. Let's find out.
say:1:1027102002:0.source_cn: 不知道他这次又有什么奇思妙想，咱们去看看吧。
say:1:1027102002:0.male: I wonder what he's up to this time. Let's find out.
say:1:1027102002:0.female: I wonder what he's up to this time. Let's find out.

say:2:1027103001:0.text: Uncle Dyan, there's a ton of open space in the garden. Should we experiment with some crops?
say:2:1027103001:0.source_cn: 迪恩叔叔，我看园子里还有不少空地，要不要试验性地种点作物？

say:3:1027103002:0.text: Glowfly fruit and jumping beans are great! The fruit can be candied, the beans fried and eaten, or even turned into slingshot pellets…
say:3:1027103002:0.source_cn: 萤瓤果和跳跳豆就很不错！萤瓤果可以榨糖，跳跳豆不但可以...

say:4:1027103003:1.text: But they're only a little bit hard on your teeth!

say:5:1027103004:0.text: Another one of your crazy ideas... You're cooking up a couple of new inventions with our produce?
say:5:1027103004:0.source_cn: 你这孩子，又在出什么坏点子？不会有新发明要用到那些果子吧？

say:6:1027103005:0.text: Yes and no. And for that, I need a huge harvest! Super huge!
say:6:1027103005:0.source_cn: 也对，也不对。确实要用，而且用量很大——超级大！！

say:7:1027103006:0.text: No one in Lunadorf knows more about gardening than you, Uncle Dyan. I'm begging you!
say:7:1027103006:0.source_cn: 整座月湖村里除了迪恩叔叔你，没人更了解种植，我只能来求你了！

say:9:1027103008:0.text: Don't be so spoiled! This is something I can't promise.
say:9:1027103008:0.source_cn: ……别撒娇啊，这件事我真的不能答应你。

say:10:1027103009:1.text: If you want fruit, find someone to go pick it with.
say:10:1027103009:1.source_cn: 要是想要果子，可以找人一起陪你去采摘嘛。

say:11:1027103010:1.text: And stop pestering me here every day. Go hang out with children your own age!
say:11:1027103010:1.source_cn: 别天天在我这逛，多和你同龄的孩子一起玩玩！

say:12:1027103011:0.text: They won't help me! When I try to be friendly, they ignore me, and they never invite me to play…
say:12:1027103011:0.source_cn: 他们才不会帮我呢！和他们打招呼，他们都当没听见，出去玩...

say:13:1027103012:0.text: Why is that? I can explain the functions of mortise and tenon joints, but I can't understand them…
say:13:1027103012:0.source_cn: 究竟是为什么呢，我能想明白榫卯和螺钉的机理，也搞不懂他...

choice_prompt:14:1027103012.text: Why is that? I can explain the functions of mortise and tenon joints, but I can't understand them…
choice_prompt:14:1027103012.source_cn: 究竟是为什么呢，我能想明白榫卯和螺钉的机理，也搞不懂他们的想法！

say:15:1027103013:0.text: Bullying? Nah, I just don't get along with them!
say:15:1027103013:0.source_cn: 针对？唔，大家没那么坏啦，我只是和他们玩不到一起！

say:16:1027103014:0.text: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!
say:16:1027103014:0.male: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!
say:16:1027103014:0.female: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!

choice_prompt:17:1027103014.text: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!
choice_prompt:17:1027103014.source_cn: 对了，<style=stress><player_name></style>——你可以帮我吗？很简单的，帮忙采一些果子就可以了！
choice_prompt:17:1027103014.male: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!
choice_prompt:17:1027103014.female: Can you help me, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? It's easy! Just pick some fruit!

say:18:1027103015:1.text: Don't worry, I know how bartering works. In exchange, I'll give you a new invention!
say:18:1027103015:1.source_cn: 放心，我懂得以物易物的道理，作为交换，把我的新发明送给你！
say:18:1027103015:1.male: Don't worry, I know how bartering works. In exchange, I'll give you a new invention!
say:18:1027103015:1.female: Don't worry, I know how bartering works. In exchange, I'll give you a new invention!

say:19:1027103020:0.text: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…
say:19:1027103020:0.source_cn: 我得友情提醒一句，不要太期待达米安的发明，至少不要指望...
say:19:1027103020:0.male: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…
say:19:1027103020:0.female: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…

choice_prompt:20:1027103020.text: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…
choice_prompt:20:1027103020.source_cn: 我得友情提醒一句，不要太期待达米安的发明，至少不要指望它们能发挥正常功能……
choice_prompt:20:1027103020.male: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…
choice_prompt:20:1027103020.female: Friendly reminder, don't expect too much from Damian's inventions. It's a miracle when they actually work…

say:22:1027103022:0.text: Then it's a deal, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Lorsan can help, too!
say:22:1027103022:0.male: Then it's a deal, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Lorsan can help, too!
say:22:1027103022:0.female: Then it's a deal, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, and Lorsan can help, too!

say:23:1027103023:0.text: Let's meet back here once we have enough!
say:23:1027103023:0.source_cn: 等找够数量了，咱们就在这儿见！
say:23:1027103023:0.male: Let's meet back here once we have enough!
say:23:1027103023:0.female: Let's meet back here once we have enough!

choice:20:1:2.text: Now I want to know more.
choice:20:1:2.male: Now I want to know more.
choice:20:1:2.female: Now I want to know more.

say:25:1027103016:0.source_cn: 哇，你连小孩子的便宜都要占吗？！

say:26:1027103017:0.text: If that's how it is… I'll give you one of my new inventions.
say:26:1027103017:0.source_cn: 既然这样……那我就忍痛割爱，把我的新发明送给你好了。
say:26:1027103017:0.male: If that's how it is… I'll give you one of my new inventions.
say:26:1027103017:0.female: If that's how it is… I'll give you one of my new inventions.

say:27:1027103018:1.text: Well... Lorsan can help! I'll even throw in one of my latest inventions!
say:27:1027103018:1.source_cn: 嗯……当然，洛桑大哥也行！我会附赠最新发明！

say:30:1027103019:0.text: How'd I get roped in? And when did you become so resourceful?!
say:30:1027103019:0.source_cn: ——这么快就找上我了？你怎么这时候这么机灵？！

choice:17:2:3.text: Does it have to be me?
choice:17:2:3.source_cn: 采果子这种事还要我来？
choice:17:2:3.male: Does it have to be me?
choice:17:2:3.female: Does it have to be me?

choice:14:0:1.text: Are the other kids bullying you?
choice:14:0:1.male: Are the other kids bullying you?
choice:14:0:1.female: Are the other kids bullying you?

say:0:1027104001:0.text: Strange thing for Damian to begin tinkering with food!
say:0:1027104001:0.source_cn: 真是稀奇，达米安竟然开始鼓捣食物了！

say:1:1027104002:0.text: I still remember the giant fruit juice machine he made…
say:1:1027104002:0.source_cn: 我还记得，他之前弄了一台榨果汁的巨大机器……

say:3:1027104004:0.text: Well... after it exploded, the Lunnos Lake was filled with fruit… that big.
say:3:1027104004:0.source_cn: 唔，怎么说呢，那东西爆炸之后，月湖上飘满了果肉……就是...

say:0:1027105001:0.text: That's enough. Let's go back to the garden and give it all to Damian.
say:0:1027105001:0.source_cn: 这些应该够了，回草药园，交给达米安吧。

say:2:1027106001:0.text: What a great haul! This is definitely enough!
say:2:1027106001:0.source_cn: 嗯……数量没错，这样就足够了！

say:3:1027106002:0.text: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! My new invention is ready. Come to my house when you're ready to pick it up.
say:3:1027106002:0.male: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! My new invention is ready. Come to my house when you're ready to pick it up.
say:3:1027106002:0.female: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! My new invention is ready. Come to my house when you're ready to pick it up.

choice_prompt:4:1027106002.text: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! My new invention is ready. Come to my house when you're ready to pick it up.
choice_prompt:4:1027106002.source_cn: 谢啦，<style=stress><player_name></style>！答应送给你的新发明，我也准备好了，什么时候去我家拿？
choice_prompt:4:1027106002.male: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! My new invention is ready. Come to my house when you're ready to pick it up.
choice_prompt:4:1027106002.female: Thank you, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! My new invention is ready. Come to my house when you're ready to pick it up.

say:5:1027106003:0.text: Drumroll, please… my latest invention is an underwater sleeping bed!
say:5:1027106003:0.source_cn: 我的最新发明——水下睡眠床！

say:6:1027106008:0.text: Simply lie down and let the retractable claws fasten you in place. It even comes with hydraulic legs that can navigate the lake floor while you sleep!
say:6:1027106008:0.source_cn: 只要躺下，这张床就能伸出勾爪，把你牢牢绑在床板上，还配...
say:6:1027106008:0.male: Simply lie down and let the retractable claws fasten you in place. It even comes with hydraulic legs that can navigate the lake floor while you sleep!
say:6:1027106008:0.female: Simply lie down and let the retractable claws fasten you in place. It even comes with hydraulic legs that can navigate the lake floor while you sleep!

say:7:1027106009:0.text: With this bed, you can sleep deeply at the bottom of the Lunnos Lake or even through a tsunami or flood!
say:7:1027106009:0.source_cn: 有了它，别说是在月湖湖底，就算是海啸洪水来了，你也能舒...
say:7:1027106009:0.male: With this bed, you can sleep deeply at the bottom of the Lunnos Lake or even through a tsunami or flood!
say:7:1027106009:0.female: With this bed, you can sleep deeply at the bottom of the Lunnos Lake or even through a tsunami or flood!

choice_prompt:8:1027106009.female: With this bed, you can sleep deeply at the bottom of the Lunnos Lake or even through a tsunami or flood!

say:9:1027106010:0.text: Well… I'm still working on that part. Currently, this model is without an underwater breathing apparatus.
say:9:1027106010:0.source_cn: 这是我正在尝试处理的问题……目前该型号不附加水下呼吸功能！
say:9:1027106010:0.male: Well… I'm still working on that part. Currently, this model is without an underwater breathing apparatus.
say:9:1027106010:0.female: Well… I'm still working on that part. Currently, this model is without an underwater breathing apparatus.

choice_prompt:10:1027106010.male: Well… I'm still working on that part. Currently, this model is without an underwater breathing apparatus.
choice_prompt:10:1027106010.female: Well… I'm still working on that part. Currently, this model is without an underwater breathing apparatus.

say:11:1027106011:0.text: Or you could tell me something else you want, and I'll make it!
say:11:1027106011:0.source_cn: 或者你告诉我你想要什么，我再帮你做也可以！
say:11:1027106011:0.male: Or you could tell me something else you want, and I'll make it!
say:11:1027106011:0.female: Or you could tell me something else you want, and I'll make it!

say:12:1027106012:0.text: Hold that thought… I got so excited and lost track of time!
say:12:1027106012:0.source_cn: 哎呀，不好，说得太兴奋，快忘记时间了……
say:12:1027106012:0.male: Hold that thought… I got so excited and lost track of time!
say:12:1027106012:0.female: Hold that thought… I got so excited and lost track of time!

say:13:1027106013:0.text: Think about it! For now, I've got a friend I need to see.
say:13:1027106013:0.source_cn: 你先想想！我要去见一个朋友，就先走啦！
say:13:1027106013:0.male: Think about it! For now, I've got a friend I need to see.
say:13:1027106013:0.female: Think about it! For now, I've got a friend I need to see.

say:14:1027106014:0.text: Wait, you made a new friend?

say:15:1027106015:0.text: Yeah! Don't mind me! I'll be back soon!
say:15:1027106015:0.source_cn: 不用担心我，我很快就回来！

choice:8:0:1.text: And it lets you breathe underwater?
choice:8:0:1.male: And it lets you breathe underwater?
choice:8:0:1.female: And it lets you breathe underwater?

say:17:1027106004:0.text: Nope, it's a bed! And it's huge… I'm betting it would take at least three people to move.
say:17:1027106004:0.source_cn: 不行，那是一张床，很大的，没有三五个人肯定搬不动。

say:18:1027106005:0.text: Of course, it's not just any bed, but one that allows you to sleep underwater in total bliss!
say:18:1027106005:0.source_cn: 当然，它不是普通的床，而是可以让你在水下安稳睡觉的发明！

choice:4:1:2.text: Can't you just bring it here?
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 不能直接拿出来给我吗？
choice:4:1:2.male: Can't you just bring it here?
choice:4:1:2.female: Can't you just bring it here?

say:19:1027106006:0.text: You could never carry its weight in gold! It's an underwater bed!
say:19:1027106006:0.male: You could never carry its weight in gold! It's an underwater bed!
say:19:1027106006:0.female: You could never carry its weight in gold! It's an underwater bed!

say:20:1027106007:0.text: When this thing goes into mass production, factoring in royalties, we're talking mountains of coins!
say:20:1027106007:0.source_cn: 水下睡眠床才刚刚做好，等到在市面上流通起来，再算上专利...
say:20:1027106007:0.male: When this thing goes into mass production, factoring in royalties, we're talking mountains of coins!
say:20:1027106007:0.female: When this thing goes into mass production, factoring in royalties, we're talking mountains of coins!

choice:4:2:3.text: I'll take its worth in gold.
choice:4:2:3.male: I'll take its worth in gold.
choice:4:2:3.female: I'll take its worth in gold.

say:1:1027107001:0.text: Excuse me, Magister, can you help me?
say:1:1027107001:0.male: Excuse me, Magister, can you help me?
say:1:1027107001:0.female: Excuse me, Magister, can you help me?

say:2:1027107002:0.text: Damian's mind works differently than other children of his age. He only has a few friends, and the ones he does, he values greatly.
say:2:1027107002:0.source_cn: 达米安思维和同龄的孩子都不同，他很少有朋友，所以才会特...

say:3:1027107003:0.text: But those are slim to none. I never knew him to have any friends outside Lunadorf except Korin.
say:3:1027107003:0.source_cn: 可是……他的朋友不多。月湖村之外，除了科林先生，我从来...

say:4:1027107004:0.text: The situation in the forest is precarious right now. Damian has gotten lost before. The whole village went looking for him. I'm worried about this happening again.
say:4:1027107004:0.source_cn: 现在丛林里的状况，太复杂了。达米安之前就走失过，村里人...

say:5:1027107005:0.text: Can you watch over him on his way to his friend? It would put my mind at ease.
say:5:1027107005:0.source_cn: 你能不能在路上帮忙看护着他？只要他平安，我就放心了。
say:5:1027107005:0.male: Can you watch over him on his way to his friend? It would put my mind at ease.
say:5:1027107005:0.female: Can you watch over him on his way to his friend? It would put my mind at ease.

choice_prompt:6:1027107005.male: Can you watch over him on his way to his friend? It would put my mind at ease.
choice_prompt:6:1027107005.female: Can you watch over him on his way to his friend? It would put my mind at ease.

say:7:1027107006:0.text: Damian is a… unique kid. He occasionally gets himself into trouble, but his heart is in the right place.
say:7:1027107006:0.source_cn: 达米安性格独特，虽然偶尔闯祸，但本心不坏。

say:8:1027107007:0.text: Look at this garden. If he hadn't helped build the irrigation and fertilization system, it wouldn't be half as fruitful.
say:8:1027107007:0.source_cn: 你看这园子，如果不是他帮忙做了洒水器和肥料培育土，也不...
say:8:1027107007:0.male: Look at this garden. If he hadn't helped build the irrigation and fertilization system, it wouldn't be half as fruitful.
say:8:1027107007:0.female: Look at this garden. If he hadn't helped build the irrigation and fertilization system, it wouldn't be half as fruitful.

choice_prompt:9:1027107007.text: Look at this garden. If he hadn't helped build the irrigation and fertilization system, it wouldn't be half as fruitful.
choice_prompt:9:1027107007.source_cn: 你看这园子，如果不是他帮忙做了洒水器和肥料培育土，也不会长得这么繁荣。
choice_prompt:9:1027107007.male: Look at this garden. If he hadn't helped build the irrigation and fertilization system, it wouldn't be half as fruitful.
choice_prompt:9:1027107007.female: Look at this garden. If he hadn't helped build the irrigation and fertilization system, it wouldn't be half as fruitful.

choice:6:0:1.text: You care quite a lot for him.
choice:6:0:1.male: You care quite a lot for him.
choice:6:0:1.female: You care quite a lot for him.

say:0:1027108001:0.source_cn: 呼……达米安那家伙，跑得还挺快！

say:1:1027108002:0.text: And with a whole cart full of fruit…
say:1:1027108002:0.source_cn: 而且还带着整整一车的果子……那份量，两三个人肯定吃不完。

say:2:1027110001:1.text: There are quite a few wagon marks on the ground here, old and new... seems Damian has made this trip before.
say:2:1027110001:1.source_cn: 地上有不少车辙印，新旧交织……看来达米安不是第一次来这里。

say:3:1027110002:1.text: What's more, there are a bunch of traps scattered about.
say:3:1027110002:1.source_cn: 而且，这么偏僻的地方，还布置了不少机关。

choice_prompt:4:1027110002.text: What's more, there are a bunch of traps scattered about.
choice_prompt:4:1027110002.source_cn: 而且，这么偏僻的地方，还布置了不少机关。

say:6:1027110004:1.text: Why would he ask his friend to meet in a place like this? Surely not to experiment with his traps...
say:6:1027110004:1.source_cn: 为什么要约朋友在这种地方见面？他该不会是想找人来实验陷...

say:7:1027110005:1.text: Speaking of which, there are no other human or Wilder footprints around. Where could his friend be?
say:7:1027110005:1.source_cn: 说起来，这附近没有发现其他人类或绿裔的脚印。达米安的朋...

say:8:1027110006:1.text: Lorsan, listen carefully... is Damian nearby?
say:8:1027110006:1.source_cn: 洛桑，你认真听听，达米安还在这附近吗？

say:10:1027110008:1.text: He's not too far ahead, and there are no other disturbing sounds. For the moment, he's safe.
say:10:1027110008:1.source_cn: 他就在前面不远处，附近也没有异响，暂时安全。

choice_prompt:11:1027110008.text: He's not too far ahead, and there are no other disturbing sounds. For the moment, he's safe.
choice_prompt:11:1027110008.source_cn: 他就在前面不远处，附近也没有异响，暂时安全。

say:12:1027110009:1.text: Good question! Tread carefully, and let's look around.
say:12:1027110009:1.source_cn: 问得好！咱们小心点，绕过去看看吧。
say:12:1027110009:1.male: Good question! Tread carefully, and let's look around.
say:12:1027110009:1.female: Good question! Tread carefully, and let's look around.

choice:11:0:1.text: What's the deal with the traps?
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 这机关到底是怎么回事？
choice:11:0:1.male: What's the deal with the traps?
choice:11:0:1.female: What's the deal with the traps?

choice:4:0:1.text: It seems he doesn't want anyone to approach.
choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 看来他不希望有人接近
choice:4:0:1.male: It seems he doesn't want anyone to approach.
choice:4:0:1.female: It seems he doesn't want anyone to approach.

say:0:1027110101:0.text: The traps have been disarmed. I wonder what Damian is hiding.
say:0:1027110101:0.source_cn: 机关全部解开了，不知道达米安到底在隐匿什么。
say:0:1027110101:0.male: The traps have been disarmed. I wonder what Damian is hiding.
say:0:1027110101:0.female: The traps have been disarmed. I wonder what Damian is hiding.

say:1:1027110102:0.text: And still no sign of his friend.
say:1:1027110102:0.source_cn: 而且到现在也没看到达米安朋友的影子……

say:0:1027111001:0.text: It's a glimmerbloom! Be careful, Magister!
say:0:1027111001:0.male: It's a glimmerbloom! Be careful, Magister!
say:0:1027111001:0.female: It's a glimmerbloom! Be careful, Magister!

say:1:1027111002:0.text: ...Huh? It ran away instead of attacking us?
say:1:1027111002:0.source_cn: ……诶？它，它竟然没有攻击我们，而是跑了？
say:1:1027111002:0.male: ...Huh? It ran away instead of attacking us?
say:1:1027111002:0.female: ...Huh? It ran away instead of attacking us?

say:4:1027112003:0.text: But just now, did you guys try to hurt Petal?
say:4:1027112003:0.source_cn: 但是你们刚才，是不是想伤害一叶？

choice_prompt:5:1027112003.text: But just now, did you guys try to hurt Petal?
choice_prompt:5:1027112003.source_cn: 但是你们刚才，是不是想伤害一叶？

say:6:1027112004:0.text: My friend! The glimmerbloom you just saw!
say:6:1027112004:0.source_cn: 我的好朋友！刚刚那只荧荧花！

say:8:1027112005:0.text: Huh?! That's the friend you wanted to meet?!
say:8:1027112005:0.source_cn: 啊？！那家伙就是你要见的朋友？！

say:9:1027112006:0.text: It's more like a pet! You even gave it a name!
say:9:1027112006:0.source_cn: 说是宠物还差不多……你甚至给它取名字了！

say:10:1027112007:0.text: Sorry, Damian... we didn't realize it was your friend. We thought it was a wild creature trying to steal the fruit...
say:10:1027112007:0.source_cn: 对不起，达米安，我们不知道它是你的朋友，还以为它是想要...

say:11:1027112008:0.text: Ah, you mean the glowfly fruit? It's for Petal.
say:11:1027112008:0.source_cn: 啊，你说那些萤瓤果吗，那些本来就是给一叶准备的。

choice_prompt:12:1027112008.text: Ah, you mean the glowfly fruit? It's for Petal.
choice_prompt:12:1027112008.source_cn: 啊，你说那些萤瓤果吗，那些本来就是给一叶准备的。

say:13:1027112009:0.text: Yes, Petal only eats sweet fruit and drinks spring water. She would never hurt anyone!
say:13:1027112009:0.source_cn: 对呀，一叶只喜欢吃甜水果，喝泉水，不会伤害任何人！
say:13:1027112009:0.male: Yes, Petal only eats sweet fruit and drinks spring water. She would never hurt anyone!
say:13:1027112009:0.female: Yes, Petal only eats sweet fruit and drinks spring water. She would never hurt anyone!

say:14:1027112012:0.text: When I was chased by the Thorned Guards, Petal dragged me into the bushes to protect me. It's thanks to her that I'm safe.
say:14:1027112012:0.source_cn: 之前外出的时候，荆棘卫队追着我不放，是一叶把我拽进草丛...

say:15:1027112013:0.text: But it was all so crazy, and we got separated in the labyrinth. When we met up again, she barely escaped from the Thorned Guards.
say:15:1027112013:0.source_cn: 可那时太混乱了，我们进入迷宫之后就走散了。再见面的时候...

say:16:1027112014:0.text: She was so badly hurt that I had to find a place for her to heal. Luckily, she's all better now.
say:16:1027112014:0.source_cn: 她满身是伤，也没地方去，我只能找个安全的地方让她养伤，...

say:17:1027112015:0.text: Only... I never expected her to have such a huge appetite.
say:17:1027112015:0.source_cn: 不过……我确实没想到她胃口这么好。

choice_prompt:18:1027112015.text: Only... I never expected her to have such a huge appetite.
choice_prompt:18:1027112015.source_cn: 不过……我确实没想到她胃口这么好。

say:19:1027112016:0.text: That's right, I've already picked all the fruit around here, so I need to keep going back near the village for more.
say:19:1027112016:0.source_cn: 是啊，附近的果子都快被我采光了，我只能回村子那边找。
say:19:1027112016:0.male: That's right, I've already picked all the fruit around here, so I need to keep going back near the village for more.
say:19:1027112016:0.female: That's right, I've already picked all the fruit around here, so I need to keep going back near the village for more.

say:20:1027112018:0.text: This doesn't add up... I didn't say I was coming here to meet Petal, so how'd you all find me here?
say:20:1027112018:0.source_cn: ……不对啊，我又没说自己要来见一叶，你们是怎么到这里来的？
say:20:1027112018:0.male: This doesn't add up... I didn't say I was coming here to meet Petal, so how'd you all find me here?
say:20:1027112018:0.female: This doesn't add up... I didn't say I was coming here to meet Petal, so how'd you all find me here?

choice_prompt:21:1027112018.text: This doesn't add up... I didn't say I was coming here to meet Petal, so how'd you all find me here?
choice_prompt:21:1027112018.source_cn: ……不对啊，我又没说自己要来见一叶，你们是怎么到这里来的？
choice_prompt:21:1027112018.male: This doesn't add up... I didn't say I was coming here to meet Petal, so how'd you all find me here?
choice_prompt:21:1027112018.female: This doesn't add up... I didn't say I was coming here to meet Petal, so how'd you all find me here?

say:22:1027112019:0.text: Of course! I knew Uncle Dyan had sent you!
say:22:1027112019:0.male: Of course! I knew Uncle Dyan had sent you!
say:22:1027112019:0.female: Of course! I knew Uncle Dyan had sent you!

say:23:1027112022:0.text: Adults are so bothersome sometimes. Assure Uncle Dyan that I'm fine. If I get in any trouble, I'll use one of my amazing inventions!
say:23:1027112022:0.source_cn: 唉，大人还真是麻烦。让迪恩叔叔放心吧，我好得很，而且万...
say:23:1027112022:0.male: Adults are so bothersome sometimes. Assure Uncle Dyan that I'm fine. If I get in any trouble, I'll use one of my amazing inventions!
say:23:1027112022:0.female: Adults are so bothersome sometimes. Assure Uncle Dyan that I'm fine. If I get in any trouble, I'll use one of my amazing inventions!

say:24:1027112023:0.text: Now I have to go find Petal... you can't tell anyone about her!
say:24:1027112023:0.source_cn: 我得赶快去找一叶了……你们千万别把她的事说出去！
say:24:1027112023:0.male: Now I have to go find Petal... you can't tell anyone about her!
say:24:1027112023:0.female: Now I have to go find Petal... you can't tell anyone about her!

choice:21:0:1.text: Uncle Dyan is worried about you.
choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 迪恩大叔担心你有危险
choice:21:0:1.male: Uncle Dyan is worried about you.
choice:21:0:1.female: Uncle Dyan is worried about you.

say:26:1027112020:0.text: No need to guess. Uncle Dyan must've sent you.
say:26:1027112020:0.source_cn: 用不着猜，肯定是迪恩叔叔让你们过来的。
say:26:1027112020:0.male: No need to guess. Uncle Dyan must've sent you.
say:26:1027112020:0.female: No need to guess. Uncle Dyan must've sent you.

say:27:1027112021:0.text: Trying to fool me cause I'm a kid? I bet Uncle Dyan sent you.
say:27:1027112021:0.source_cn: ……糊弄小孩子吗，估计是迪恩叔叔委托你们来的吧。
say:27:1027112021:0.male: Trying to fool me cause I'm a kid? I bet Uncle Dyan sent you.
say:27:1027112021:0.female: Trying to fool me cause I'm a kid? I bet Uncle Dyan sent you.

choice:21:2:3.source_cn: 如果我说是路过，你信吗？

choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 所以你才到处搜集果子？

say:28:1027112017:0.text: If the Thorned Guards or anyone from the village saw Petal, she'd get captured for sure!
say:28:1027112017:0.source_cn: 要是被其他村人或是荆棘卫队看到，一叶肯定会被误解抓住的！
say:28:1027112017:0.male: If the Thorned Guards or anyone from the village saw Petal, she'd get captured for sure!
say:28:1027112017:0.female: If the Thorned Guards or anyone from the village saw Petal, she'd get captured for sure!

choice:18:1:2.text: Can she find her own food?
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 为什么不让它自己去找？
choice:18:1:2.male: Can she find her own food?
choice:18:1:2.female: Can she find her own food?

say:29:1027112010:0.text: I said Petal is a friend and meant it... there's a huge difference between a friend and a pet!
say:29:1027112010:0.source_cn: ——朋友，都说了一叶是朋友，和宠物有本质区别！
say:29:1027112010:0.male: I said Petal is a friend and meant it... there's a huge difference between a friend and a pet!
say:29:1027112010:0.female: I said Petal is a friend and meant it... there's a huge difference between a friend and a pet!

choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 好哇，你在这里养宠物呢

say:30:1027112011:0.source_cn: 哦……哦！太好了，你能理解我吗？！

say:0:1027113001:0.text: Woahhh! Where did all these glimmerblooms come from?!
say:0:1027113001:0.source_cn: 哇啊啊啊——！！怎么、怎么有这么多荧荧花？！

say:1:1027113002:0.text: These ones look different... like they want to hurt Damian!
say:1:1027113002:0.source_cn: 不好，这几只看起来不一样，好像要伤害达米安！

say:2:1027114001:0.text: *Sigh*... they're finally gone. I hope they don't come back...
say:2:1027114001:0.source_cn: 呼……它们终于走了，不会突然又跑回来吧……？

choice_prompt:3:1027114001.text: *Sigh*... they're finally gone. I hope they don't come back...
choice_prompt:3:1027114001.source_cn: 呼……它们终于走了，不会突然又跑回来吧……？

say:5:1027114004:0.text: ... It's so strange. The glimmerblooms have always stayed far away from the village. Why did these ones show up suddenly and attack?
say:5:1027114004:0.source_cn: ……太奇怪了。荧荧花一向远离村落附近，这两只为什么会突...

say:6:1027114005:0.text: And fleeing like that... it doesn't seem like they intended to do any real harm.
say:6:1027114005:0.source_cn: 而且，它们见势不对就立刻逃跑，说明目的不是要伤害我们……

say:7:1027114006:0.text: Where's Petal? How's Petal?! Have any of you seen Petal?!
say:7:1027114006:0.source_cn: 一叶呢，一叶怎么样了？！你们有谁看见一叶了？

choice_prompt:8:1027114006.text: Where's Petal? How's Petal?! Have any of you seen Petal?!
choice_prompt:8:1027114006.source_cn: 一叶呢，一叶怎么样了？！你们有谁看见一叶了？

say:9:1027114007:0.text: She can't run too far! If someone finds out about her, she's done for... we have to find her quickly!
say:9:1027114007:0.source_cn: 她不能跑太远呀！要是被人发现就糟了，得赶快找到她！

say:10:1027114008:0.text: We'll go with you to keep you safe.
say:10:1027114008:0.source_cn: 我们和你一起去，以免路上又有危险。

say:12:1027114003:0.text: I-I was too scared to react.
say:12:1027114003:0.source_cn: 我、我只是被吓到了，没反应过来而已……
say:12:1027114003:0.male: I-I was too scared to react.
say:12:1027114003:0.female: I-I was too scared to react.

say:0:1027115001:0.text: Glowfly fruit... Petal must've dropped this!
say:0:1027115001:0.source_cn: 萤瓤果……这应该是一叶掉落的！

say:1:1027115002:0.text: And another up ahead! Let's follow them!
say:1:1027115002:0.source_cn: 前面也有！我们跟着果子走，就能找到她了！

say:0:1027115101:0.text: There's no sign of it here. Let's search the area and see.
say:0:1027115101:0.source_cn: 到这里就没有踪迹了，我们在附近搜寻看看吧。

say:0:1027115201:0.text: Hurry up! There's glowfly fruit over here!

say:0:1027115301:0.text: Still haven't found Petal... I wonder if she has any fruit on her...
say:0:1027115301:0.source_cn: 还是没找到一叶……不知道她身上还有没有果子……

say:0:1027116001:0.text: I see her! Petal's over there!

say:1:1027116002:0.text: Be careful! There are Thorned Guards nearby!
say:1:1027116002:0.source_cn: 小心点，那边是荆棘的人！

say:2:1027117001:0.text: You there! You're the ones who hurt Petal before!
say:2:1027117001:0.source_cn: 你们——你们就是之前欺负一叶的那些家伙！

say:3:1027117002:0.text: Huh, where did this kid come from? Mind your business. We're keeping the peace!
say:3:1027117002:0.source_cn: 啧，哪来的小孩，少多管闲事，我们在维持正常治安！

say:4:1027117003:0.text: Pesky creatures like glimmerblooms threaten the safety of Wilder territory. They must be destroyed!
say:4:1027117003:0.source_cn: 荧荧花这种野生生物，只要闯入绿裔居住的区域，都可能会造...

say:5:1027117004:0.text: Glimmerblooms are native to the forest, just like us! They're just different!
say:5:1027117004:0.source_cn: 荧荧花和我们一样，都是丛林的原住民。它们只是和我们长得...

say:6:1027117005:0.text: If she's trespassing, just send her away? Why hurt her? This land isn't just for Wilders!
say:6:1027117005:0.source_cn: 你说她闯入有人居住的领地，那把她送回野外就好了，干嘛要...

say:7:1027117006:0.text: Light-blasted fool! Don't you have the common sense to stay clear of wildlife? Didn't your parents ever teach you anything?
say:7:1027117006:0.source_cn: ——无知且愚蠢！连远离野生生物的常识都不知道，你父母没...

say:8:1027117007:0.text: Your idea of common sense doesn't make any sense at all!
say:8:1027117007:0.source_cn: 你说的不是常识，没有这种没有道理的常识！

say:9:1027117008:0.text: Then I'll teach you a lesson on behalf of your parents!
say:9:1027117008:0.source_cn: 那我今天就替你父母，好好教训教训你吧！

choice_prompt:10:1027117008.text: Then I'll teach you a lesson on behalf of your parents!
choice_prompt:10:1027117008.source_cn: 那我今天就替你父母，好好教训教训你吧！

say:11:1027117009:0.text: Hmph! Where did this human come from?
say:11:1027117009:0.source_cn: 哼，这又是从哪冒出来一个人类……
say:11:1027117009:0.male: Hmph! Where did this human come from?
say:11:1027117009:0.female: Hmph! Where did this human come from?

say:12:1027117010:0.text: Isn't that Lyca and Lorsan? Seems like the kid is also from Lunadorf.
say:12:1027117010:0.source_cn: 这么一瞧，旁边这两位不是莱卡和洛桑吗？看来，这小子也是...

say:13:1027117011:0.text: Wait... is he one of Granny Dahnie's orphans? His name is Damian, right?
say:13:1027117011:0.source_cn: 我记得你们达赫妮贤者收养的那个孤儿……叫达米安吧，莫非...

choice_prompt:14:1027117011.text: Wait... is he one of Granny Dahnie's orphans? His name is Damian, right?
choice_prompt:14:1027117011.source_cn: 我记得你们达赫妮贤者收养的那个孤儿……叫达米安吧，莫非就是他？

say:15:1027117012:0.text: What's it to you? Hurry up and let go of Petal!
say:15:1027117012:0.source_cn: ……是我又怎么样！快点放开一叶！

say:16:1027117013:0.text: I've heard of you... head in the clouds, always working on some useless invention. Ignored by all the other kids...
say:16:1027117013:0.source_cn: 我听说过你。总是一个人在搞无用的发明，满脑子都是不切实...

say:17:1027117014:0.text: Pretty pathetic... No parents, no friends, so you befriend a monster...?
say:17:1027117014:0.source_cn: 哎呀，还真是可怜啊。没有父母，没有朋友，所以才把情感投...

say:18:1027117015:0.text: Petal is not a monster! She's my friend!
say:18:1027117015:0.source_cn: 一叶不是怪物！！她是我的朋友！

say:19:1027117016:0.text: It's you who's pathetic. Why can't Wilders be friends with glimmerblooms? Isn't everything in the Dark Forest under the protection of Misarte?
say:19:1027117016:0.source_cn: 狭隘的是你们才对，人为什么不能和荧荧花做朋友？丛林里的...

say:20:1027117017:0.text: I don't have friends my own age to explore the unknown with, but that doesn't mean I'm alone... not one bit!
say:20:1027117017:0.source_cn: 虽然没有同龄的朋友和我一起探索未知的乐趣，但是我……我...

choice_prompt:21:1027117017.text: I don't have friends my own age to explore the unknown with, but that doesn't mean I'm alone... not one bit!
choice_prompt:21:1027117017.source_cn: 虽然没有同龄的朋友和我一起探索未知的乐趣，但是我……我不孤单……一点都不孤单！

say:23:1027117019:0.text: The affairs of the Dark Forest do not concern you!
say:23:1027117019:0.source_cn: 薄暮丛林的事务，没有你插话的地方！
say:23:1027117019:0.male: The affairs of the Dark Forest do not concern you!
say:23:1027117019:0.female: The affairs of the Dark Forest do not concern you!

choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 达米安只是眼界和常人不同

say:4:1027120003:0.text: As long as you're alright... You scared me running around like that.
say:4:1027120003:0.source_cn: 只要你没事就好，别再乱跑吓我了……

say:9:1027120006:0.text: Wait... those two seem to be the glimmerblooms that attacked Damian just now!
say:9:1027120006:0.source_cn: 等等……那两只好像就是刚才袭击达米安的荧荧花！！

say:11:1027120007:0.text: Calm down, Lorsan. They don't seem to want to hurt us right now.
say:11:1027120007:0.source_cn: 洛桑，别这么激动。它们现在并没有想要伤害我们的意思。

say:14:1027120009:0.text: I see... I think they want to take Petal back with them.
say:14:1027120009:0.source_cn: ……果然。它们……是想接一叶回去吧？

say:19:1027120011:0.text: ...It's happening faster than I thought it would.
say:19:1027120011:0.source_cn: ……来得好快啊，比我想象的还快呢。

choice_prompt:20:1027120011.text: ...It's happening faster than I thought it would.
choice_prompt:20:1027120011.source_cn: ……来得好快啊，比我想象的还快呢。

say:21:1027120012:0.text: I... I'm not sad. I'm happy for her.
say:21:1027120012:0.source_cn: 我、我没有伤心，我在替它高兴……

say:23:1027120014:0.text: Don't look at me like that... We should be happy, right? You can finally be reunited with your family...
say:23:1027120014:0.source_cn: 你别这样看着我啦……我应该替你高兴的，对不对？你终于能...

say:26:1027120016:0.text: Um... what is Petal trying to say?

say:28:1027120018:0.text: You don't have to try and comfort me, Petal...

say:29:1027120019:0.text: Y-You go with them. It's time for you to go home.
say:29:1027120019:0.source_cn: 你……你跟着它们回去吧。回家去。

choice_prompt:30:1027120019.text: Y-You go with them. It's time for you to go home.
choice_prompt:30:1027120019.source_cn: 你……你跟着它们回去吧。回家去。

say:31:1027120020:0.text: It's hard, but I know this is for the best.
say:31:1027120020:0.source_cn: 当然舍不得……但是，让一叶回去才是最好的选择。

say:32:1027120023:0.text: She's got her own family and friends to love and care for... it's a good thing!
say:32:1027120023:0.source_cn: 它有自己的族群，有同伴爱护它、关心它……这很好！

say:33:1027120024:0.text: I know what it's like not to have a family... I wouldn't wish that on anyone...
say:33:1027120024:0.source_cn: 我……我不想要它离开家人。没有家人的感觉，我最清楚了……

choice:30:0:1.text: Are you able to let go?
choice:30:0:1.male: Are you able to let go?
choice:30:0:1.female: Are you able to let go?

say:35:1027120021:0.text: No... If I don't let her return now, then I'll really regret it in the future.
say:35:1027120021:0.source_cn: 才不会呢。如果现在不让一叶回归族群，以后才是真的会后悔。

say:36:1027120022:0.text: I know... but I shouldn't interfere. Petal needs to decide for herself.
say:36:1027120022:0.source_cn: 我知道……但在这件事上，我不能替一叶做出任何选择。

choice:30:2:3.text: She may want to stay with you.
choice:30:2:3.source_cn: 它也许会想留下来陪你
choice:30:2:3.male: She may want to stay with you.
choice:30:2:3.female: She may want to stay with you.

say:1:1027121002:0.text: Since when do you not have a family? Have you forgotten about me?
say:1:1027121002:0.source_cn: 你什么时候没有家人了？难道是把我忘了不成？！

say:2:1027122001:0.text: Granny Dahnie?! Why are you here?
say:2:1027122001:0.source_cn: 婆……婆婆！您怎么到这里来了？

say:3:1027122002:0.text: Because of you, of course! You're running around, getting lost, and dragging our distinguished guest, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, into your messes?!
